intent.raw: Run the selected next step after TASK-ARE-READINESS-001.
intent.objective: Produce an evidence-backed proposal-only refresh that reconciles passed policy readiness with stale planning and Craft surfaces without authorizing implementation.

technique_overlays.trigger: The source result closes readiness blockers, while mutation and target execution remain separately authorized.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The proposal separates Invoke-owned planning deltas, Craft-owned ledger/view deltas, and the later SWU execution route.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Single bounded local synthesis from a terminal receipt into a proposal-only artifact set.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Parallel agents would add join overhead without creating independent evidence lanes; no delegated mutation or adversarial judgment is needed.
context: The prior Task Session has already produced and independently reviewed the controlling evidence.
This route edits only new refresh proposal artifacts.

steps.name: Author readiness synchronization proposal
stop_conditions: Stop if any controlling evidence digest differs from the terminal receipt.
Stop if the target inventory cannot be resolved.
Stop before changing planning, Craft, implementation, canonical, or public target artifacts.
Stop if a proposed status exceeds policy-readiness evidence.

gates.condition: The terminal receipt passes and every controlling evidence digest matches.
The proposal preserves implementation_authorized false, routes Craft mutations to Craft, and leaves SWU execution separately authorized.
Required refresh artifacts exist, every proposed delta maps to a RefreshSignal, and JSON/dispatch validation passes.

boundaries.contract: Consume the terminal readiness receipt at its policy-readiness claim ceiling and author proposal artifacts only.
Invoke describes the Craft delta but does not mutate the Craft ledger or its generated projections.
Proposal completion grants no apply or SWU execution authority.

authority.validation: Dispatch Spec and Invoke refresh mode gates.
authority.evidence: TASK-ARE-READINESS-001 terminal receipt and pinned policy digests.
authority.promotion: Target lifecycle owners retain apply, implementation, and claim authority.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only during this proposal; mutation requires a Craft lifecycle refresh.
Read-only during proposal-only; apply requires explicit apply-approved authorization.

promotion_splits.rule: May mark the policy gate and readiness task complete, but may only mark SWU-ARE-001 ready-awaiting-explicit-authorization.
No promotion is allowed without later execution evidence and the named promotion owner.

promotion_guardrails: A pass refresh status describes proposal completeness only.
No evaluator implementation or semantic witness is created.
No private content is moved into public Arcanum.
No canonical definition or general reasoning-engine claim is promoted.
